opening.argument: Oracle Advanced Customer Support is presented as part of Oracle Customer Support services, with offerings for Oracle products in both on-premise and cloud settings. The closing invites interested customers to reach out and schedule a deeper conversation about support costs, availability, and performance. That is a service inquiry tied to the IT support work described throughout the statement. It does not ask viewers to send money, provide credentials, or join an investment opportunity, and it makes no claim that any customer has already achieved those benefits.

citations.quote: Advance Customer Support, or ACS, operates globally as a part of Oracle Customer Support services
Oracle Advanced Customer Support has service offerings for every Oracle product including traditional on premise and cloud.

If you're interested in obtaining the highest value possible from your Oracle investment by lowering your support costs and increasing availability and performance, reach out. We can schedule a deeper conversation.
